natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: I intend to simplify onboarding because completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, directly matching the observed problem. The inherited evidence indicates that shortening onboarding improved completion and time-to-value, while reducing required signup fields lifted SMB first-week activation. I would verify both records before committing, then run a small guarded test measuring completion, first meaningful action, qualified pipeline or revenue quality, and retention proxies—not just signup or activation lift. This is more sustainable than deep discounting, which may attract price-sensitive users while harming renewal.
